input.title: Reference Stack Interoperability Profile
input.description: Shared semantic assumptions for the current RAES reference authoring, exchange, processing, and execution stack.

behavior_assumptions.statement: Authoring remains SDL-native while declared meaning is grounded in the shared concept authority rather than artifact-local labels.
RAES-native concept families follow the explicit extension-scope, relation-rule, and non-ambiguity discipline declared in the concept catalog.
Processor and backend capability exchange uses the shared v2 apparatus manifest envelope instead of divergent role-specific manifest shapes.
Operational exchange surfaces preserve the published typed runtime snapshot, result, history, receipt, and status envelopes.
Processors declare their interoperable processing surface through the shared v2 apparatus manifest, published contract versions, and concept bindings.
Instantiation and planning produce only the published plan, cancellation, receipt, status, and snapshot contracts for interoperable downstream use.
Execution targets declare interoperable realization capabilities through the shared v2 apparatus manifest and governed concept bindings.
Execution results, histories, and snapshots preserve the published typed control-plane envelopes rather than backend-local payload conventions.
